sources.snippet: Overview SeedVR2-3B performs one-step video restoration using diffusion adversarial post-training, developed by ByteDance-Seed. This model restores degraded video by removing compression artifacts, blur, noise, and other quality issues in a single inference step, avoiding the computational prohibitiveness of multi-step diffusion approaches.
